title: Strong direct product for entanglement-assisted one-way quantum communication

license.adaptation_notice: Faithful editable TeX collection of formal author Theorem1, complete Section3 anchoring/distribution/protocol construction and Lemma30/31/32 proofs including all information, projector, unitary, channel and final coordinate-selection continuation. Required exact probability/CQ-state facts, local conditioning and substate proof, communication model and prior compression/embedding facts are retained with their original conditions. Original Figure1 is cropped from the official PDF as a diagram asset, not a source-page substitute. Full published bibliography retained. Typographic macros expand to the original register bundles. Author mathematical expressions and conditions are uncorrected; no new proof or assumptions. Only official CC BY4.0 content used; arxiv2008.08963/ECCC are identity aliases, and related arxiv2106.04299 is not an alias.

standard_prerequisites.name: Quantum substate, Uhlmann and Quantum Raz lemmas
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact author Facts13--24 and stated hypotheses retained.

standard_prerequisites.name: Measurement-based message compression
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact Fact25[29] with full author explanation of the adapted register/entropy formulation retained.

standard_prerequisites.name: Classical embedding and minimax
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact Facts10/12[19,25], Fact28[45] and local conditioning proofs retained.

core_obligations: Preserve arbitrary relation, epsilon/zeta/alphabet dependence, entanglement-assisted one-way and worst-case/distributional models.
Retain complete anchoring, correlation-breaking, embedding, state-conditioning and message-compression proof chain.
Keep all technical support and parameter branches in one main direct-product item; no overview substituted for Lemma32 proof.
difficulty_reason: The authors use one-sided anchoring and correlation-breaking variables for nonproduct inputs, then condition on success of selected coordinates. Quantum Raz/substate estimates yield local projectors and unitaries; a commuting measurement argument and compressed shared-state sampling embed one instance and contradict the one-way communication bound. The complete nonroutine quantum-information chain is explicit.
